leo (devx): quick thread: we've seen a few customers trip over ESM/CJS parity, edge failures, and types not resolving. want to align on a publish checklist.

anya (pkg): agree. goal: 1 pkg, both builds, clear exports, predictable types.

sam (runtime): constraint: Edge (Workers) = pure ESM, zero node builtin usage. any cjs shims break. add explicit ./edge export.

mira (ts): TS quirks: conditional exports don't always map types. suggestion: publish a single flattened dist/types/index.d.ts and use typesVersions for older TS.

leo (devx): small package.json pattern we tried:
exports: { ".": {"import":"./dist/esm/index.js","require":"./dist/cjs/index.js"}, "./edge": {"import":"./dist/esm/edge.js"} }, types: "dist/types/index.d.ts"

anya (pkg): +1. also ship a tiny cjs wrapper file at the root that does module.exports = require('./dist/cjs/index.js') for old bundlers (no runtime logic).

sam (runtime): CI must include: (1) edge smoke test in a Worker runtime, (2) bundle check (esbuild) to fail on global/node APIs, (3) auth/retry regression test across builds.

ci-bot: CI: redwood-sdk@publish edge-smoke failed 2026-03-18T08:12:05Z  Error: Uncaught ReferenceError: require is not defined - logs: https://ci.internal/9999

mira (ts): types smoke: add a sample consumer and run tsc --noEmit in CI to catch missing declarations. ensure index.d.ts declares both default and CommonJS interop shapes.

leo (devx): docs: standardize examples to ESM import default, include a CJS appendix snippet.

anya (pkg): publish checklist draft: build -> dist/esm/node, dist/esm/edge, dist/cjs; types -> dist/types/index.d.ts; package.json -> conditional exports + types; small cjs wrapper; CI -> edge smoke, bundle lint, tsc smoke, retry regression.

sam (runtime): I'll add the bundle lint and edge smoke to runtime pipeline this sprint.

mira (ts): I'll write the types publishing note and provide example d.ts template.

leo (devx): final call: keep single tarball/version. no objections?

anya (pkg): none. i'll open RFC PR with exact package.json + scripts.

leo (devx): assigning follow-ups: @anya RFC, @mira types doc, @sam CI. thanks! :rocket
